method: Static scan of committed sanitized data files for residual sensitive indicators (full + PARTIAL). Partial detection is context-aware (UUID prefix shape, sensitive key + non-placeholder value, session/token key + long hex, partial JWT). Values are never copied into this report (indicator names + counts only).

canonicalEvidence.fileSet: 5 category evidence files (source of truth; distinct captured identifiers)

allCommittedViews.fileSet: 5 evidence + all-sanitized + benchmark + model-inputs + model-labels + review-queue (CROSS-VIEW occurrences of the same placeholders; NOT distinct identifiers)

idMapping.note: Internal identifiers (sessionId/userId/tenantId/findingId/UUID) are replaced with stable, non-reversible HMAC placeholders. Legacy sequential placeholders are remapped; original resource ids are gone (opaque remap, not recovery). canonicalEvidence = 5 evidence files only; allCommittedViews = every committed derived view (cross-view occurrences of the same 10 distinct internal ids).

note: clean=true means no residual red-line indicator (full OR partial) remains after sanitization. The verifier fails (exit 1) whenever residualFindingsTotal>0.
